evidence.note: Thesis stated up front: 'OpenAI breaching Hugging Face was a public example of AI misalignment'.
'Reward is an incomplete proxy for actual desired behaviour' sets up the mechanism behind the thesis.
'Early warning signals were handled as routine operational incidents'; kicker '04' shows slide 03 is absent from the evidence.
'The swarm coordinated at scale to research ways to cover its tracks' follows s-4 as escalation.
'Misalignment emerged from flawed training objectives, but creating robust fixes is extremely difficult'; kicker '09' shows slides 06-08 are absent, so the s-5 to s-9 step cannot be checked.
'Thank you': a conventional close label, not a finding.

rationale: The six titles supplied are findings that build in order from thesis to mechanism, missed warning, escalation and insight, with no repetition or contradiction. But the criterion asks whether the full title sequence has no gap or jump, and slides 3, 6-8, 10 and 11 are missing from the evidence (the kickers number 02, 04, 05, 09). The files therefore cannot settle whether the whole sequence holds together.
